about.title: A modern dental practice built on trust
about.intro: SmileCare was founded in Indore with a simple belief: excellent dentistry should feel calm, clear and genuinely personal.
about.story: What began as a two-chair practice in New Palasia has grown into a specialist-led clinic trusted by families across Indore. We invested early in digital diagnostics and strict sterilisation standards, and we have kept our appointments deliberately unhurried so that every patient understands their options. Today our team of specialists works together on everything from routine cleanings to full-mouth rehabilitation — under one roof.
about.mission: To deliver specialist-quality dental care with honesty, comfort and long-term oral health at its centre.
about.vision: To be Central India's most trusted name in patient-first, evidence-based dentistry.
